verdict.rationale: Stable publishes a per-endpoint API reference at docs.usestable.com/reference, with pages for authentication, signature packets, onboarding sessions and company deactivation, and offers an llms.txt. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (e.g. a try-it console) or includes runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/console in the reference, runnable code examples, a public OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
